lines.en: From the left, eh?
There you are!
From the right, eh?
There you are!!

That pathetic swipe
won't affect me!

How dare you harm
my precious ATAC!
lines.ru:
Как ты смеешь
портить мой АТАК!

lines.en:
What in the names of
the gods was THAT?
lines.ru:
Во имя богов, ЭТО
что было?

lines.en:
Don't try to stop me.
Get out of my way!
lines.ru:
Не мешай мне. Прочь
с дороги!

lines.en: You maggot!!
GRRRRR!!

You have unleashed
my wrath!
lines.ru:
Ты навлёк на себя
мой гнев!

lines.en:
Your insolence will
not be forgiven!
Yarrgghhh!
Arrrghhhh!
Who ARE you?!
Stop it, you fiend!
I have been crushed!

My beautiful ATAC!
How could you?!
lines.ru:
Мой прекрасный
АТАК! Как ты мог?!

lines.en:
This cannot be! This
is a terrible mistake!
lines.ru:
Не может быть! Это
ужасная ошибка!

lines.en:
This is what losing a
battle is like?
Cowardly fiend!

Are you afraid of a
fair fight?!

You expect to harm
me with that attack?

Ha, ha, ha! That was
all too easy!

Should I stand still
next time?
lines.ru:
Мне в следующий раз
постоять смирно?

lines.en:
Be careful, now! You
might hurt yourself!

Dodging my attack is
NOT allowed!!

I will destroy you
soon enough!
You--!

Show some courtesy
and allow me to hit!

Your attack is but a
trifling blow!
Urrrk!

You will pay for that
attack, fool!
Damn you!
I saw you coming!

That was a rather
obvious attack!
Arrgghhhh!!
What was that?!

Your lack of skill is
quite depressing.
What are you doing?!

The Continent will
be mine to control!

You should have been
honored to fight me!
lines.ru:
Сразиться со мной —
честь для тебя!

lines.en:
You will make a fine
slave in my palace!
lines.ru:
Будешь славным
рабом в моём дворце!

lines.en:
Beg forgiveness and
I might not kill you.
lines.ru:
Моли о пощаде,
может, и не убью.

lines.en: Grraahhh!
Rrrahhhh!

You cannot stop my
glorious ambitions!
Behold my power!
Bow down before me!

My anger will result
in your defeat!

How dare you strike
a legendary leader?!

Gaze upon the power
of my mighty ATAC!

You are unworthy of
my attention!

Are you prepared for
your eternal rest?
Here I come!
What?!

This is my first step
toward destiny!
